title: Deeper/broader ACAD_TABLE DWG writer identity and peer-route refresh

scope.question: Does the current DWG writer preserve typed ACAD_TABLE identity and semantic content, and what is the fastest safe implementation route?

observations: DRW_Table derives from DRW_Insert and declares TABLE-specific parsing/model fields, but no encodeDwg override was found in the class.
DRW_Insert::encodeDwg assigns object type 7 for INSERT or 8 for MINSERT and emits the insert payload.
The AC1015/R2000-era and AC1024+ entity writer paths call the virtual entity encodeDwg method; dwgRW::writeTable forwards through generic entity output.
This is source-confirmed writer incompleteness and a potential silent identity/content loss. No runtime reproduction or producer-authored wire trace was performed.

external_evidence.supports: ACAD_TABLE has a distinct AcDbTable subclass and includes table style/owner links, dimensions, cell types and values, FIELD references, block-cell links, attributes, and overrides.
external_evidence.does_not_support: DWG binary layout or local writer qualification.

external_evidence.supports: AcDbTable derives from AcDbBlockReference while retaining a distinct cell-content model.

external_evidence.report: The author reports that an AC1032 no-op read/write loses one of two TABLE entities, does not persist a cell edit, and creates a file AutoCAD 2020 rejects with ErrorStatus 53; a no-table control reportedly succeeds.
external_evidence.limit: Peer-reported only. No sample was attached or imported, no peer run was performed, and the issue is neither normative wire evidence nor proof of a libdxfrw defect.

external_evidence.supports: Peer spec source distinguishes TABLE and a separate R2010+ TABLECONTENT lane.
external_evidence.limit: Corroborative only; ODA v5.4.1 remains byte-layout authority and empirical traces are required for local object-type dispatch.

external_evidence.supports: Project documentation says DWG is read through ACadRust and projected into a 2D application model.
external_evidence.limit: Same parser lineage; not an independent DWG parser/writer or TABLE semantic oracle.

external_evidence.supports: Project documents a Binary-DXF-only R13+ parser with a bounded common-entity list and Unknown fallback.
external_evidence.limit: Not a DWG route or TABLE/ACIS semantic oracle; optional syntax comparison only.

plan_changes: Add a generated local TABLE-versus-INSERT writer identity and sentinel control under existing PAR-126/7G.3d.
Fail closed atomically for DWG TABLE profiles that do not yet have an exact encoder; never report a TABLE write as successful INSERT/MINSERT output.
Capture the real producer DWG object type from repository-approved debug traces before implementing per-version dispatch; do not hardcode peer-derived type numbers.

Implement the pre-AC1024 TABLE entity lane separately from the AC1024+ TABLE/TABLECONTENT object graph, preserving TABLESTYLE, owner, cell state, FIELD/DATALINK, block-cell, and attribute links only when mapped.
Keep the graphical *T display block distinct from semantic table cells and require semantic completeness or explicit refusal/loss.
Use generated in-memory controls and fast owning tests per slice; defer full composed/native gates to a once-per-composition checkpoint and self-unblock around unavailable external evidence.
After each implementation slice is committed, refresh the plan/receipt and report progress; do not commit peer-provided drawing fixtures.
limitations: Source inspection identifies the inherited encoder path but does not replace a generated runtime reproduction.
No producer-authored TABLE trace was captured; object type and versioned field layout must be verified before encoder implementation.
Peer issue symptoms may reflect ACadSharp-specific causes and are not attributed to libdxfrw.
